text:
Ava (Product): Quick UX nit — KMS toggle and the little retention summary in Project Settings are confusing at a glance. Screenshot: https://redwood/snap/abc123 (mock)
Ben (Design): I noticed that too. The toggle only uses color (green/gray) and the pill says "Enabled" but it can be ambiguous when disabled + BYOK label is next to it.
Carmen (Security): Concern: relying on color alone is an accessibility fail. Users with low vision or colorblindness won't catch it. Also audit log events like "KMS key changed" are vague. We need explicit verbs (rotated, disabled, deleted).
Elliot (Frontend): Proposed quick fixes:
- Add an explicit state text inside the pill: "Enabled" / "Disabled".
- Add a small state icon (lock / lock-open) + text so color isn't the only signal.
- Update aria-labels for screen readers.

Example aria suggestion:
```
<button aria-pressed="true" aria-label="KMS encryption: enabled, customer-managed key">🔒 Enabled</button>
```

Retention summary issue: the little line reads "Retention: 30d" but customers ask whether that's policy or effective retention after exports/overrides. We should show both:
- Policy: 30 days
- Effective: 15 days (overridden by route X)

Ava (Product): Nice. Also copy: we use "BYOK" a lot — propose changing to "Customer-managed key (BYOK)" on first mention and keep "BYOK" in parentheses.

Carmen (Security): Audit log copy recommendations:
- Replace "KMS key changed" -> "KMS key rotated (user: alice@example.com, method: console)"
- For deletions: "KMS key deleted — immediate detection required" (makes it easier to triage)

Elliot (Frontend): Minimal CSS contrast tweak while we ship icons: make the enabled pill background #0B66FF (blue) and text white, disabled pill #F2F4F7 with #101828 text. That avoids red/green reliance.

Ben (Design): UI microcopy proposals (single-line options for designers to try):
1) "Customer-managed key (BYOK) — Enabled"
2) "Customer-managed key (BYOK) — Disabled; click to manage"
3) Retention summary: "Policy: 30 days · Effective: 15 days (route override)"

Ava (Product): Small accessibility note: add a "What's this?" link that opens a tiny tooltip with the exact definition of "Effective retention" and a link to docs. Makes support triage easier.

Carmen (Security): One more: audit event structure should include machine-readable event codes so downstream SIEMs can filter. Eg: `kms.rotate`, `kms.delete`, `kms.disable` alongside the human text.

Elliot (Frontend): I'll put together a tiny PR with aria-label changes + icon SVGs. Will also stub the new copy variants as i18n keys.

Ben (Design): I'll mock 3 variants and drop PNGs in Figma by EOD. :thumbsup:

Ava (Product): Thanks — sounds good. Can we make the copy change to "Customer-managed key (BYOK)" a styles-only toggle so translations aren't blocked?

Elliot (Frontend): Yes — put text in i18n key `settings.kms.label.byok_full` and we can ship with English fallback.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for settings microcopy PR #412 on 1945679000 — staging only.

Ava (Product): Awesome. Follow-ups: Ben to upload mocks, Elliot to open PR, Carmen to confirm audit schema. I'll update the product notes.
